messages:
alex: FYI, running the Aegis-7B quant bakeoff (AWQ vs GPTQ) on the L40s pool hit a tiling/shard fallback in the vLLM path when CUDA 11.8 drivers are used. results look noisy.
maya: ugh, what's the exact symptom? OOM or correctness delta?
alex: Not OOM. Triton reports a kernel fallthrough -> TRT-LLM fallback for some layers. Throughput drops ~35% and latency spikes on long context. Accuracy delta: AWQ has ~1.8% regen delta vs fp16 on our eval set.
kevin: Can you paste the Triton logs? Also which vLLM revision and TRT-LLM shim are we using?
alex: logs below

```
[triton_server] 2026-02-11 14:22:11.234 - WARN - kernel_select: layer 27 unsupported quant op, falling back to cpu_path
[vllm] 2026-02-11 14:22:11.235 - INFO - using plugin: trtllm_plugin_v2.4
[trtllm] 2026-02-11 14:22:11.300 - WARN - dynamic_tiling: driver mismatch detected: cuda=11.8 / toolkit=12.1 -> disable fast_tiling
```

alex: Note the driver/toolkit mismatch line. We're on CUDA driver 11.8 but container has toolkit 12.1.
maya: That mismatch is suspicious. Last time we saw that it caused kernel symbol versioning to force slow paths.
jen: Which quant config did you use for AWQ? any per-channel vs per-tensor toggles?
alex: AWQ default gauge, per-channel enabled for attention matrices. config: `{"quant_bits":4, "gtype":"awq", "per_channel": true, "kv_cache": "sharded"}`
kevin: sharded KV + per-channel quant + toolkit mismatch = a lot of moving parts. I think TRT-LLM disables tiled kernel and returns to CPU/triton fallback for some kernels which then hits vLLM and serializes.
triage-bot: Created INC-4932 for "Aegis-7B quant path tiling fallback on CUDA-toolkit mismatch" assigned to eng-ml.
build-bot: sha: a1b2c3d -> kicked off replicate-run: bakeoff/aegis7b/2198765432 with variants: [awq, gptq], drivers: [11.8, 12.1], trtplugin: [v2.3, v2.4]
maya: Can we repro with driver/toolkit aligned (11.8/11.8) and then with 12.1/12.1 to see which direction is worse?
alex: yes running that now. preliminary: 11.8/11.8 -> no kernel fallthrough, AWQ throughput ~x1.1 of prior run, accuracy delta still ~1.7%. 12.1/12.1 -> fallthrough occurs for gptq also but different layers.
jen: So driver mismatch made throughput worse, but didn't cause the AWQ accuracy regression. That suggests an algorithmic quant delta or inference loop bug.
kevin: Agreed. Two threads: 1) fix tiling/fallback/loss of perf (infra) 2) investigate AWQ regressing on eval set (model/quant)
alex: For perf triage, I looked at symbol versions: trtllm plugin built against CUDA 12 headers. When loaded into driver 11.8 it disables fast paths. We should either build plugin against minimum supported SDK or install compatible driver on L40s images.
maya: Ops: what was the driver we rolled to the L40s nodes last week? I thought we pinned 12.1 for new nodes.
kevin: Some legacy nodes are still 11.8, autoscaler reuses them. We'll push a node upgrade pool tag to Dedicated and mark the old nodes as drain.
triage-bot: INC-4932 updated: added label "driver-mismatch" and linked PR #4721 (infra/drivers: add 12.1 pool tag)
jen: On the accuracy side: can we run the AWQ quantization with `per_channel=false` and `kv_cache=local` to isolate whether sharded kv affects rounding?
alex: Running that now. Quick numbers: AWQ per_channel=false drops regen delta to ~0.9% (better). GPTQ with per_channel=false is ~0.7% delta.
maya: Interesting. So per_channel quant is amplifying error for attention matmuls with long ctx.
kevin: That may be due to our calibration dataset not sampling long contexts. AWQ per-channel scales need long-prefix-aware calibration.
jen: Let's try re-calibrating with longer prefix examples and a second pass of min/max collectors.
alex: Done. New AWQ with long-prefix calib: regen delta ~0.3% for top-1, throughput same as fp16 with aligned drivers. Looks promising.
maya: Great. Action items:
- infra: upgrade legacy L40s nodes to driver 12.1 or rebuild trtllm plugin against 11.8 (kevin)
- q-experiments: add long-prefix calibration to AWQ pipeline and rerun bakeoff with per_channel true/false (jen, alex)
- docs: add guidance about driver/toolkit mismatch causing tiling fallbacks (alex)

kevin: I'll also run a stress test with vLLM streaming + sharded-kv under 12.1 to confirm no regressions.
alex: leaving raw logs and quant configs in INC-4932. ping me if you need the bakeoff matrix.
maya: thanks. feel free to assign follow-ups in INC. :thumbsup:
kevin: also reassigning a small perf task to eng-infra to add node labels to avoid mixing driver versions.
triage-bot: INC-4932 status changed to "in_progress".
